summary: Phase 1 Zynthoro homepage + presale signup fully tested. Backend pytest 7/7 passing. Frontend Playwright covers all 14 requested checks: title/meta, navbar (incl. mobile toggle), hero, social proof badges (Claude/XPRIZE), Why section H2, 12 domain cards, 4 pricing cards with prices and Most Popular badge, Assist/Comparison/PresaleCTA/Footer, Watch Demo scroll-to-domains, nav link scrolling, presale dialog open/submit/success, duplicate email returns 409 with toast 'This email is already on the presale list.', mobile hamburger menu shows links + Start Free Trial CTA.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/status endpoints store timestamp as ISO string but response_model expects datetime - dual format handling works but inconsistent.
PresaleDialog: dialog state persists across reopens which is fine, but on duplicate-submit the form is not reset between sessions (UX nit only).
test_credentials: N/A - public homepage, no auth in Phase 1.
seed_data_creation: Test signups inserted with TEST_/dup_test_/ui_test_ prefixed emails in presale_signups collection (MongoDB). Safe to leave; no production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_presale.py and exercise root, signup (valid/dup/dup-case-insensitive/invalid email/missing name), and /presale/count increment. Frontend selectors all use data-testid from /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds/home.js. Mobile breakpoint is md (<=768). Backend URL via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (currently https://zynthoro-foundation.preview.emergentagent.com).
